 Follow Young & Restless Star Eileen Davidson Just Got a New Role
 Shazmeen Navrange Wed, October 28, 2026 at 4:37 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: CBS Eileen Davidson recently landed a role in an Off-Broadway production featuring a mix of current and former cast members of Bravo's Real Housewives franchise. One another actress will also play the same role, as the play features two different sets of cast members performing on different dates. Davidson is best known for her soap opera roles, including Ashley Abbott in The Young and the Restless and The Bold and the Beautiful, as well as her various roles in Days of Our Lives.
 Eileen Davidson to make her New York stage debut in Rumors
 Davidson is set to appear in an off-Broadway production of Neil Simon's Rumors. She will be taking the role of Claire Ganz, alongside another actress from the Real Housewives franchise. She will be part of the second cast, which will perform from March 2 through April 21.
 This batch of cast members includes Cynthia Bailey (The Real Housewives of Atlanta), Carole Radziwill (The Real Housewives of New York City), and Candiace Dillard Bassett (The Real Housewives of Potomac).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to PEOPLE , the Y&R actress' character is described as a "sharp-tongued socialite." The play centers on four couples who come together for an anniversary party. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the wives goes missing, the host sustains a wound, and the police head to their home. This announcement was also shared on Instagram, where many took to Davidson's comment section to express enthusiasm for her New York Stage debut.
 A user wrote, "This is going to be MAJOR." Another one added, "I am so sat." A third mentioned, "THIS is my Ultimate Girls Trip." Other reactions included, "Is this real? it sounds too good to be true," "Amazing lineup! Can't wait to see this play!" and "Fantastic." Apart from her daytime soap roles, Davidson appeared in The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills and The Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip.
